title: THE NEEDLE'S EYE
tagline: She hemmed his alibi. Now she'll rip it out.
concept: 1971 Rome. A blind tailor identifies the killer of her client by the distinctive stitching on his gloves — and he knows she knows. Giallo thriller shot on 35mm Eastmancolor.

title: DIAL M FOR MOON
tagline: One frequency. Two empires. No sign-off.
concept: 1959. A switchboard operator at a secret Soviet lunar listening post intercepts an American astronaut's mayday that officially never happened — and both empires want the tape. Cold War thriller on 16mm Kodak Ektachrome.

title: PIVOT
concept: A quirky team of founders builds an AI startup in a loft and learns important lessons about synergy, hustle culture, and believing in yourself.
